rows.grounds: describes the all-pervasive nature of the subjects
connective particle adding a further attribute
indicates continuity with the preceding account
universal quantifier referring to all beings or selves
emphatic particle restricting or affirming identity
compound denoting beings whose essence is awareness of self

items.question: What universal nature belongs to all beings as pervading self-awareness?
premises: All beings are pervading in nature.
All beings are likewise characterized without exception.
All beings are identical with self-awareness.
items.inference: Therefore, every being is universally pervading and essentially constituted as self-awareness.
uncertainties: Whether sarve and sarva qualify the same subject or function distributively is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: And likewise, all are pervading; indeed, all are nothing but self-awareness.
